authentication.web: HttpOnly SameSite cookie plus X-CSRF-Token on writes; native Authorization Bearer
authentication.workspace_selection: X-Workspace-ID authorized by membership; default workspace if omitted

database_seam: from .db import transaction, fetch_record, insert_record, update_record; from .security import require_session, Session; with transaction(session) as conn uses RLS; fetched record shape above; insert_record(conn, kind, data) and update_record(conn,kind,id,expected_revision,data); fetch_record(conn,kind,id)
session_seam: Session dataclass: user_id, workspace_id, role, csrf_token; require_session FastAPI dependency

field_file_imports.preview: POST /farms/{id}/field-imports with expected_farm_revision,filename,format:geojson|kml,contents,source_year:null|integer,source_origin:my_file|public_reference; stable Idempotency-Key. Complete bounded UTF-8 polygon file only; no ZIP, CRS conversion, skipped invalid features or network links. Returns private RecordItem without raw contents.
field_file_imports.detail: GET /field-imports/{id}; same-farm read permission and interactive session. 100 preview rows maximum, explicit metadata and warnings.
field_file_imports.propose: POST /field-imports/{id}/propose with expected_revision,expected_farm_revision,selected_ids:1..20,note,acknowledged:true. Exact idempotent retry preserves one whole proposal; stale farm needs a new preview. Does not match, replace, retire or approve existing fields.
field_file_imports.approval: Existing separately acknowledged proposal approval applies all selected new fields atomically against the unchanged farm revision. Overlaps remain explicit. Imported source IDs never become official parcel identifiers automatically.

lpis_guidance: GET /farms/{id}/lpis-guide and read-only assistant read_lpis_guide with exact farm revision. Source-specific manual CZ drawing, NL GPS handoff and SK owned/rented-land register steps; other EU countries get a general official starting page with detailed steps/formats unknown. No official update, verified upload schema or acceptance.
cap_example: POST /examples/cap acknowledged:true and stable Idempotency-Key creates one explicitly fictional owner-only private draft scenario. GET /examples/cap/{run_id} derives current checks/progress under actual farm permissions. The web /app/examples/cap walks through authored claim/reference differences, missing records, real private field approval, case review and folder download. Sample notice dates and protected-area notes are not legal findings or satellite observations; no automatic submission or acceptance.
funding_guidance: GET /farms/{id}/funding-guide: optional sourced AGRIP promotional-campaign information, not individual CAP support. Organisation eligibility is not assessed; 2026 closed call and unknown future calls remain separate. No application action.

farmer_questions.start: Existing POST /adviser/ask-farmer creates a private farm-scoped question. Home and adviser views link to /app/tasks/{id}; /app/tasks optionally filters a farm.
farmer_questions.list: GET /tasks?task_state=active|all&farm_id=&limit=&offset=. Active filtering precedes pagination and its total counts all matching permitted tasks, not just the visible page. Legacy missing status is open; unknown statuses are not silently completed.
farmer_questions.answer: Existing PATCH /tasks/{id} with expected_revision and data:{notes,status}. Preserve the asked question, keep actual answer text, and require an answer or reason before closing an adviser question. Separate human save, original revision and explicit conflict comparison; notes are not confirmed farm facts or evidence of legal compliance.
farmer_questions.home: task_preview gives exact scoped active/due/overdue counts plus explicit bounded preview truncation. Home combines up to20 task dates with actual request/case dates and up to5 task actions; critical existing actions remain first.
farmer_questions.clients: Web and native task details use current farm grants, protected account-bound drafts, exact writes and conflict recovery. Related files and paperwork remain separately opened records, not automatically attached or completed.

documents.upload: POST /documents multipart file, optional farm_id and Idempotency-Key

source_imports.upload: POST /imports multipart file, grain, farm_id, format_profile, source_year:2026, delimiter:auto|comma|semicolon|tab; generic CSV still defaults to comma
source_imports.rows: GET /imports/{id}/preview then POST /imports/{id}/rows/review; saves proposals only
source_imports.meaning: Exact source column strings with separate source-year/holding/decimal review; no mapped parcel mutation, inferred certification, accepted upload format or government submission. Country-report row_schema is retained inside each snapshot.

facts.review: POST /facts/{id}/review {expected_revision,decision,note}; confirmation only by explicit actor

czech_journal.pack: cz-ppp-journal-2026; schema cz-ppp-journal-v1; manual preparation from the ÚKZÚZ record example published30March2026, not JUDPOR transmission or legal certification
czech_journal.capture: Existing workflow check/capture and separate operations review. Each pesticide_application operation UUID is one actual application, including separate applications on the same field/date. cz_ppp retains conditional LPIS/cadastral/forest/object identifiers, subject, actual crop dates, pending follow-up and original numeric text. Do not infer identifiers, authorization, units, quantities or future actual dates.
czech_journal.holder: Separately confirmed static fact cz.ppp.holder with explicit kind, name, address, identification-number status/value and birth_date where supplied; never inferred from farm display name
czech_journal.correction: supersedes_id points to a same-farm confirmed operation. Only separate confirmation retires the predecessor; competing confirmed successors return409 operation_correction_conflict. CZ operations GET adds read-only top-level journal_issues,active,confirmed_successor_id. Confirmed originals remain immutable.
czech_journal.guidance: GET /workflow/questions?request_id&journal_limit<=200&journal_offset returns journals with full authorized counts and bounded entries/pagination. Existing greater-than10k input guard returns an explicit review_too_large error; failed/unloaded pages are not zero or complete.
czech_journal.selection: Linked request GET /requests/{id}/checks?selected_operation_ids=comma-separatedUUIDs must match POST /reports.operation_ids. Without a linked letter, create a manual journal draft with farm_id,pack_id,reporting_year,operation_ids and optional fact_ids; server checks it before separate bound approval. Assistant preview_journal proposes the same manual draft for visible human review, never confirmation or issuing. Reissue remains request-less when its original is request-less.
czech_journal.review: snapshot.journals retains source hash, columns, holder and entry identities; bounded operation review items include journal_entry with schema,pack,title,country,reporting_year,source,columns,entry. Existing report page/count/byte limits and immutable full exports remain unchanged. Missing core details block approval; legitimate pending follow-up stays visibly pending.

portuguese_journal.pack: pt-ppp-surface-journal; schema pt-ppp-surface-v1. Literal manual preparation from the retained DGAV surface-treatment workbook; not verified filing or legal applicability.
portuguese_journal.capture: Existing facts key pt.ppp.surface_journal, static/null period and unit. Value holds identity_text, global observations_text and up to256 UUID entries with exactly13 string-or-null cells, separate actual_date and date_confirmed. Partial undated drafts retain literal null, empty, whitespace, zero and identifiers. GET /facts?farm_id&fact_key filters before pagination.
portuguese_journal.review: Explicit confirmation is separate from saving. Optional sources are exact actual document_id/document_revision pins. Confirmed corrections create a supersedes_id successor; originals stay retained.
portuguese_journal.selection: Existing POST /reports and reissue require explicit manual_journal_selection:{source_fact_id,source_fact_revision,entry_ids,acknowledged_unresolved:true}. Source must be current/confirmed; selected rows need independently confirmed actual dates within the app-selected year. No operation, date inference, totals or private unselected raw rows enter the recipient snapshot.
portuguese_journal.readback: journals retains ordered raw cells, source/version metadata and excluded row IDs/reasons/dates. Normal bounded mapped report fields carry row/date/column context; the producer field carries bounded journal_context. CSV/PDF repeat headers and identity in16-row blocks, with observations once. Full JSON retains exact source values and metadata; CSV protects formula-like cells.
portuguese_journal.clients: Dedicated web/native journal editors handle capture, review, exact request and revision-bound correction context. Generic guided answer routes return an actionable journal-editor link rather than interpreting the table as text. Assistant tools can stage an unconfirmed draft only, with every date_confirmed false. Human row selection, date confirmation and final approval remain separate.

guided_cases.jobs: fields, correction and inspection share farm-scoped cases under Paperwork. Links from actual letters, requests, reports and field changes retain exact selected source revisions; no fabricated submission.
guided_cases.routes: GET/POST /cases; GET/PATCH /cases/{id}; GET /cases/{id}/checks; POST /cases/{id}/review; GET/POST /cases/{id}/events; GET /cases/{id}/events/{event_id}; POST /cases/{id}/items; POST /cases/{id}/items/{item_id}/review; GET /cases/{id}/handoff; GET /cases/{id}/packet
guided_cases.review: Explicit human review binds current case/farm/source revisions and report dependency state. Changed sources invalidate readiness. Historic originals can remain stale evidence of what needs correcting; new response reports must pass their own approval/currentness checks.
guided_cases.events: Sending, receipts and decisions are recorded by a person, not verified with an authority. Event writes return {case,event}. Separate retained event records preserve the sent selection; original issued reports and official registers are not changed.
guided_cases.items: Requested records, findings and actions have explicit notes, deadlines, document evidence and separately recorded completion or cancellation. Unknown national obligations are not inferred.
guided_cases.handoff: Known official starting route, copyable answers and same-origin report/field exports. Field exports include expected_revision and fail on mismatch; no portal prefill, automatic filing or acceptance claim.
guided_cases.packet: GET /cases/{id}/packet requires reference_fingerprint plus exactly one positive expected_revision for current ready preparation or retained_revision for the pre-send sealed_bundle.case_revision. Private ZIP with exact Content-Length, index.html/index.txt, file-hash manifest, selected readable records, immutable report PDF/JSON/XLSX and private field exports. Original attachments only from explicit case documents, item pins and selected report snapshot.evidence, never all private validation sources. Current farm grants and exact retained data hashes apply; missing included files fail the whole request. Source JSON budget 8MiB per record/32MiB aggregate, report complexity budget, 512 files/128MiB folder and cooperative 90s preparation limit. Cancellation preserves cleanup; an active renderer is checked when it returns. Old seals without a packet link retain individual exports. Web has bounded cancellable reading; native clients stream privately then offer explicit sharing.
guided_cases.verification: Verification evidence lives in private runtime checkpoints. Final builds, tests and deployment are now explicitly authorized; passing local checks do not establish authority acceptance, legal completeness or physical-device validation.

packs: GET /packs?country=DE&year=2026; GET /packs/{id}; static definitions under packs/*.json; actual mapping != reference only

reports.receipt: POST /reports/{id}/receipts {expected_revision,reference,date}; manual receipt not authority acceptance

report_transport.summary: Optional view=summary on report list/create, approval/reissue and fact/operation/sale report-dependency lists. Existing envelopes and default responses stay compatible. data.transport_view=summary contains compact report identity, status, checksum, approval, pack/farm metadata and counts, not full snapshots or source-validation arrays. Mutation projection follows idempotency handling.
report_transport.review: GET /reports/{id}?view=review returns compact record plus data.review {report_revision,snapshot_checksum,check_fingerprint,sections,page_limit:5,byte_limit:2097152}, current can_approve, supported_formats and approval_blocked_reason. sections maps fields,operations,evidence,blockers,changes,receipts,reissues to exact counts. No eager section arrays.
report_transport.page: GET /reports/{id}/review?section=fields|operations|evidence|blockers|changes|receipts|reissues&expected_revision&snapshot_checksum&check_fingerprint&offset&limit<=5 returns {items,total,limit,offset,next_offset,section,report_revision,snapshot_checksum,check_fingerprint}. Complete retained items only, serialized response bounded to2MiB; next_offset uses actual count and is null at end. Oversized individual items fail explicitly, never truncate. Dynamic sections also reject changed check fingerprints with409.
report_transport.approval: Native explicit approval sends expected_revision,snapshot_checksum,check_fingerprint. Server revalidates current checks under existing locks; optional bindings do not weaken legacy approval checks. A missing/failed review page is not a complete review.
report_transport.files: Full immutable report downloads unchanged. Native report exports stream into private bounded temporary files before explicit OS sharing, with cancellation/account-switch cleanup; no whole-export JSON or byte-array caching.

web.api: apps/web/src/api.ts: get, post, patch, upload, download; post supports a stable idempotencyKey
web.components: apps/web/src/components.tsx; hooks.ts useRecords; auth.tsx useSession; offline.ts usePrivateDraft
web.module_exports: Core: HomePage/FarmPage/FarmDetailPage; RecordWork: RecordWorkPage; Requests/Documents/Reports: list and detail pages; ImportPage: ImportsPage; Adviser: AdviserPage; FieldsMap: FieldBoundaryWorkspace; Compliance: CompliancePage/UpdatesPage; Help: HelpPage; Community: CommunityPage; AssistantConnect: AssistantConnect; Support: GuidancePage/SettingsPage

countries.coverage: Common record workflows in EU27; country and regional mapping and official connections have explicit separate status.

authority_reads.hungary: hu-nebih-egn-read; operator-approved configuration and owner-supplied encrypted eGN diary token required
authority_reads.work: POST /connections/{id}/read-diary-operations {expected_revision,consent:true,field_read_id,site_id,use_id}; selected identifiers must come from the same connection revision's field read
authority_reads.meaning: Human-browser-only partial private snapshots, not confirmed facts or authority writes. Codes, dates and coordinates are not inferred; production interoperability remains unverified.

field_corrections.export: GET /field-proposals/{id}/export?format=geojson|kml|correction; optional expected_revision for a current-version check OR retained_revision for an explicit historical download, never both
field_corrections.related_records: GET /field-proposals/{id}/related-records?section=reports|facts|operations|requests|cases&expected_revision&limit<=50&offset; exact scoped counts and bounded summaries for explicit field links, not automatic invalidation or an exhaustive match of unlinked records
field_corrections.meaning: Private snapshots with retained parent lineage and review status; KML requires a valid outline for every parcel. A supplied expected revision must still match, otherwise409. Historical downloads use immutable record_history under current farm grants. No official LPIS write, authority acceptance or eligible-area claim.

compliance.profile: POST /compliance/farms/{id}/profile {year,expected_farm_revision,answers:[{key,value}]}; proposed typed answers, never auto-confirmed
compliance.checklists: POST /compliance/farms/{id}/checklist {rule_ids,year,expected_farm_revision,expected_input_fingerprint?}; draft checklists and open tasks
compliance.meaning: Source-backed evidence review, not legal certification, eligibility or authority acceptance

regulatory.worker: Bounded global public-source polling; per-actor farm relevance and read state stay tenant scoped
regulatory.meaning: A changed official page is a review signal, not an automatically effective legal rule

advice.qualifications: Self-declared until independent evidence review; expiry removes current reviewed status

assistant_connection.flow: S256 PKCE, browser-bound owner consent, exact allowed callback, rotating refresh tokens and revocable farm-limited read/propose access
assistant_connection.chat: GET /assistant/chat/status; POST /assistant/chat {farm_id,message,language,include_farm_context,history?}; optional local fallback, no autonomous actions

satellites.meaning: Measurements and proposed context, never confirmed farm operations or legal eligibility.

assistant.restriction: Dedicated ffa_ keys can only read or propose within selected farms. They cannot call native/account/approval/filing routes. All clients use the same server rules.

isolation: Server membership and PostgreSQL FORCE RLS; runtime role nonowner nonbypass. Original files private scoped UUID namespaces. Confirmed record revisions and issued reports immutable. Assistant credentials are additionally farm- and tool-limited. Government credentials require encryption, explicit setup and verified adapters; reference handoffs are never filing acknowledgements.
